blocks.text: Straight from the pros to you. Bring It Home Beauty Hair Care presents an easy-to- follow, step-by-step visual instruction DVD so you can cut and trim, create highlights, color, and style hair, even special occasion looks, right in the comfort of your own home. Best of all, you can create beautiful salon styles for a fraction of the cost any time you want. Treat yourself and your family members with no appointment necessary! Created for the non-beauty professional by a team of licensed beauty experts, this DVD shows easy, step-by-step, close-up video as our pros teach you how to create the look you want. You can easily see and hear the details and have the option to look back and review each step so you can master the skills and produce successful results. Each procedure lists the tools and supplies you will need along with visual instructions of what to do. You will learn about safety and sanitation so that you can develop your own trouble-free technique. You will see exactly how to cut, color and style hair so you and your family always look their best! You will learn: Proper techniques for holding shears and a comb, Basic bang trim, Basic long hair cut, Cutting hair short with clipper, Cutting hair short with shears, Highlighting hair with foils, Coloring roots, Beautiful French braids, Creating casual, and formal up-dos Safety and Sanitation,
